biography.value: A Worldsea Colossus does not freeze things. It converts the local environment into ice and then continues from there. World Glaciation on arrival creates permanent permafrost across an 80-foot diameter and Restrains everything within it for an hour. Primordial Cold Aura compounds cold conditions through multiple stages automatically — a Restrained enemy in the aura takes 34 cold damage per round from aura effects alone before the Colossus ### Attacks them. Glacial Apocalypse Engulfs at Margin 2 with no save. A summoner who calls one has determined that the fight ends in ice, and what the Worldsea Colossus determines is where the ice begins. Water Fae

system.attacksNotes:
Glacial Apocalypse [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 20 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (8 + 7 Str) + 5 cold damage (Half DR); target immediately Frozen + Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 cold damage; immediately Engulfed in ice; Blinded + Grappled + Restrained; ongoing 10 cold damage per round; no save; Might/Acrobatics [Hard] check as full [Combat] action each round to escape.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 cold damage + Engulfed; escape requires Might check with Misfortune, or ally intervention (4 [Interact] actions with fire, 6 without); ongoing damage increases to 14

World Ice Storm [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 200 ft, 30-foot diameter

  • Margin 1:: 20 cold damage (17 + 3 Dex) + Frozen + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 20 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + Prone + Restrained for 1 round.
  • Margin 3: 20 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + Prone + Restrained + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save on any effect.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Primordial Cold Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 25 feet take 11 cold damage (Half DR). Frosted creatures become Frozen. Frozen creatures take additional 12 cold damage and become Restrained. Restrained creatures take additional 8 cold damage as ice continues accumulating. World Glaciation (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases the cold of the world's deepest ice in an 80-foot diameter. All non-designated creatures make a Fortitude [Hard] save.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage only. The radius becomes permanent permafrost until magically cleared.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen for 1 minute.
  • Margin 3: 14 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen for 1 hour + Restrained for 1 hour; escape requires fire or an ally's sustained effort.

Cold Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 6 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical cold damage within 60 feet. Powerful Build: Worldsea Colossus counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Permafrost: Ground within 50 feet of the Glacier Giant where it has stood for at least 1 round becomes frozen. Frozen ground is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving across it make Acrobatics [Easy] checks or fall Prone. Ice Stride: Moves across ice and snow at full speed. Creates a thin frost trail wherever it walks; surfaces within 5 feet of its path become Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Worldsea Colossus fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
